definitions.gloss: guaranteed quality; certified; of proven merit
definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone whose quality, skill, or authenticity has been officially or widely recognized. Used to vouch for the excellence of a person's abilities or the quality of an item.

examples.english: That restaurant's food is of guaranteed quality.

examples.japanese: {折|お}り{紙|がみ}{付|つ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{語学力|ごがくりょく}→語学力：29443_gogakuryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{折|お}り{紙|がみ}{付|つ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{赴任|ふにん}→赴任：10601_funin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧だ。
examples.english: Her language skills are vouched for even by her teacher, so there's no worry about her overseas assignment.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{折|お}り{紙|がみ}→折り紙：05408_origami⟧ (folded paper, certificate) + ⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ (attached). Historically, ⟦{折|お}り{紙|がみ}→折り紙：05408_origami⟧ referred to a certificate of appraisal for swords, tea utensils, and other valuable items. When something came with such a certificate, its quality was guaranteed — hence the modern figurative meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}り{紙|がみ}{付|つ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧: proven ability
- {折|お}り{紙|がみ}{付|つ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧: guaranteed quality
- {折|お}り{紙|がみ}{付|つ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧: certified skill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{太鼓判|たいこばん}→太鼓判：16998_taikoban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to vouch for, to guarantee — more active, implies someone is actively endorsing
- ⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with guarantee — more literal and commercial

ETYMOLOGY:
The ⟦{折|お}り{紙|がみ}→折り紙：05408_origami⟧ here is not the paper-folding art, but rather a type of formal certificate used in the Edo period to authenticate the value of swords and art objects.
